4.  **Blue light dominance**: As a result of this scattering, the blue light is dispersed in all directions, reaching our eyes from all parts of the sky. This is why the sky appears blue during the daytime.
5.  **Angle of the sun**: The angle at which the sun is viewed also affects the color of the sky.
